label: PF Backlog 556
title: Worker ops: worker charter (binding guidelines) + runtime prompt fix (no agent merge) + model pin
body:
## Why
The worker runtime prompt told the agent to merge to develop, causing duplicate PRs (#17 by the agent + #18 by
PF delivery). Also, the worker charter was thin and did not encode the operator's binding guidelines, and the
worker model was unpinned (used an unavailable default).

## What
- workergrid/instructions.md: full worker charter (14 binding guidelines; manual-by-default, auto mode).
- workergrid/config.json: runtime prompt -> implement + commit only (no push/PR/merge; PF owns delivery);
  pin --model opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash.

## Verify
- BM-PF worker rerun: claim -> worktree -> opencode -> commit -> PF delivery (single PR), item completed.
